title: REMOVAL OF COOLING UNIT / DISASSEMBLY OF COOLING UNIT

content.description: Photo showing hands working on upper part of cooling unit with hoses and connections visible

items: DISCONNECT SUCTION FLEXIBLE HOSE FROM COOLING UNIT OUTLET FITTING
DISCONNECT LIQUID LINE TUBE FROM COOLING UNIT INLET FITTING

content.text: Cap the open fittings immediately to keep moisture out of the system.

content.description: Photo showing connector on cooling unit with label pointing to connector

items: REMOVE GROMMETS FROM INLET AND OUTLET FITTINGS

REMOVE FOLLOWING COMPONENTS:
(a) Glove box with undercover
(b) Side air duct

content.description: Photo showing removal of cooling unit with nuts and bolts visible

items:
REMOVE COOLING UNIT
Remove the three nuts and four bolts.
REMOVE A/C WIRE HARNESS FROM COOLING UNIT

content.description: Photo showing hands removing lower case of cooling unit with screwdriver

items:
REMOVE LOWER CASE
Using a screwdriver, remove the four clamps, and four screws.

REMOVE UPPER CASE FROM EVAPORATOR
Remove the two screws.
